name: Backstage Pass
source:
The glamour and glitz of showbiz hold little appeal for Sian. As the daughter of a professional makeup artist, she knows how stressful and uncertain work can be, and she aspires to something more stable. When a sudden accident topples her plans for a smooth college life, she realizes she must put her own makeup skills to use if she wants to make it through the year. The entertainment world may be wild and unpredictable, but Sian is about to learn there's also a lot to love…

[From [url=http://sakevisual.com/backstagepass/info.html]official website[/url]]
translation:
演藝圈的魅力和浮華對希安來說沒有什麼吸引力。作為專業化妝師的女兒，她知道工作的壓力和不確定性有多大，她渴望更穩定的工作。當一場突如其來的事故打亂了她順利大學生活的計畫時，她意識到如果她想度過這一年，就必須運用自己的化妝技巧。娛樂世界可能是狂野且難以預測的，但希安即將瞭解到還有很多值得熱愛的事物……

［來自[url=http://sakevisual.com/backstagepass/info.html]官網[/url]］
